name: Pitch Ball
hook: Round players, one ball, hold Kick and score.
how: Run around the pitch, bump the ball to dribble and hold Kick to shoot it into the far goal. First team to 5, or the leader after 3 minutes; a tie goes to golden goal.
controls: WASD or arrows to run, Space or click to kick · touch: drag to run, hold Kick
uses: One player's browser moves the ball and runs the clock, so everyone sees the same bounce; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill every empty spot, so even alone you play 3 against 3.
Every player and the ball move for everyone at once.
ideas: Make the ball bigger and bouncier
Add a speed boost button with a cooldown
Make it ice hockey on a frozen rink
